📊 *weekly triage digest* — 2026-07-20 → 2026-07-27

⚠ *Window note:* 2026-07-20, -21, -22 show zero triage activity (no actionable file, 0 incident-log lines) — the tail end of the already-diagnosed 8-day laptop-hibernation gap (2026-07-15 17:08Z → 2026-07-23 20:11Z), not a bot failure. Live polling resumed 2026-07-23 20:12Z and has run at normal cadence since (last week's "confirm the fix holds" item — it's holding). ~4.7 of this window's 7 days had live polling. The *prior* comparison week (07-13→07-20) was even more dark (only ~2.1 of 7 days live, ending right as the gap began), so every Δ below is comparing a full week against a mostly-dark one — not a real signal. Treat this as a second consecutive digest recovering from the same gap, not organic week-over-week movement.

*Volume:* 227 alerts triaged (256 incoming, 29 deduped into existing groups) · 61 posted · 96 suppressed to digest (+ 70 false-alarm self-DM confirmations, counted separately — no post, no digest entry)

*Top recurrences this week*
| occ | Δ vs last wk | entry | fix_status |
|-----|--------------|-------|------------|
| 27 | n/m* | ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap | monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed |
| 23 | n/m* | ki-2026-07-03-method-ui-grid-dropdown-performance-test-nodata | confirmed-non-prod-noise |
| 12 | n/m* | ki-2026-07-04-ms-account-api-4xx-spike-monitor-noise | monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed |
| 10 | n/m* | ki-2026-07-06-rainforest-merchant-details-503-serviceunavailable | third-party-dependency-monitor-only |
| 9 | n/m* | ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring | investigating |
| 7 | n/m* | ki-2026-07-06-synthetics-signin-transient-step-duration-spike | needs-human |
| 6 | n/m* | ki-2026-07-03-eda-consumer-amqp-stopped-publishing | escalated-for-review |
| 6 | n/m* | ki-2026-07-07-gateway-4xx-spike-monitor-noise | monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed |
*n/m = not meaningful, see window note above (raw deltas were +25/+12/+11/+7/+4/+2/+5/+5 respectively vs a mostly-dark prior week — inflated, not reported as real movement)

*New this week:* none (no KB entries with first_seen in this window)

*Aging:* 7 of this week's active entries have fix_status unchanged ≥30d — oldest: `ki-2026-07-03-method-ui-grid-dropdown-performance-test-nodata`, `confirmed-non-prod-noise`, ~85d (first_seen proxy — KB doesn't track a separate status-change timestamp). Also aging: `ki-2026-07-03-warehouse-dashboard-network-test-nodata` (~81d), `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring` (~64d, still just `investigating`), `ki-2026-07-06-synthetics-signin-transient-step-duration-spike` (~60d), `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout` (52d since its last real status change to `chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05` — this one has a real change-date, not a proxy — 582 occurrences all-time, the KB's single largest entry).

*Concentration:* top 3 (crm-amqp flap, grid-dropdown, ms-account-api 4xx) = 62 of this week's 137 KIR fires (45%) — below Method's standing ~66% all-time top-3 concentration. This week's chronic noise was more spread across entries, not more concentrated.

*Suppression ratio:* known-issue-recurrence — 82/137 (60%) suppressed inside the 24h window, 55 posted (window-expiry or 10th-occurrence resurface). needs-human — 14/20 (70%) daily-cap-deferred to actionable.md (cap=5/day) rather than DM'd, 6 posted. Recurrence posts this week all logged as `message_type=known-issue`; the daily-cap grep still checks for `known-issue-recurrence`, so none of these 55 posts count against the cap — the same enum mismatch flagged before, still unaddressed.

One thing worth doing next week: `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout` has sat at `chronic-residual-post-rollback` for 52 days at 582 occurrences (the KB's largest entry by far) — worth an actual status decision (mitigated / wontfix / reopen) instead of continuing to auto-resurface it on the 24h window every day.

  - 0 receiver-side errors on runtime-core-api for this resource in the window

Suggested next action: file defect / monitor — no Method-side fix identified; if this multi-hour-but-self-resolving shape recurs, consider a KB entry distinct from the existing brief-gap false-alarm
